author: claude-design
scope: Independent visual game-asset candidates for AC-130W/AC-130J: GAU-23/A, aircraft 105mm assembly, EO/IR sensor turret. Public API metadata and published thumbnails only. No weapon engineering or tactical parameters.
result: No exact, licensed, immediately retrievable component selected. Author detailed visual components from primary photo references; keep candidates recorded for future rights/access review.
limitations: Search results are not exhaustive proof of absence.
Triangle, animation, texture and material counts are API claims; no model binaries were inspected.
isDownloadable is listing status, not proof of authenticated download capability.
Sketchfab uploader license does not independently establish original source provenance.
No purchases, account login, unofficial extractors, viewer mesh downloads, or model binary ingestion occurred.
